title: The Little Dragon Who Couldn't Fly
synopsis: The golden star clue shows Lumi and Bobo a magical mountain, where they meet Draco, a little purple dragon who can't fly yet. With practice, encouragement and believing in himself, Draco finally soars above the mountain.
ending: The golden star returns and shows a glowing map of a mysterious moonlit castle beyond the clouds. What is waiting there?
newCharacters: Draco, a small baby dragon with soft purple scales, big eyes, small rounded wings and tiny golden horns (Draco in src/ep04/props.tsx)
